BR-18

BRAKE SYSTEM — Master Cylinder

4. INSTALL TWO GROMMETS

5. INSTALL RESERVOIR
(a) Install the cap and strainer to the reservoir.
(b) Push the reservoir onto the cylinder.
(c) Install the set screw while pushing on the reservoir.
Torque: 17.5 kg-cm (15.2 in.-lb, 1.7 N-m)

NOTICE: Because the master cylinder and reservoir tank union is a grommet type, the set screw is designed to not separate the reservoir from cylinder and will not tighten down the reservoir. Therefore, there is a clearance at point A. Do not insert washers or an equivalent when tightening.
